'''Flek''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. They were part of a group that were stranded on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[4 BBY]] following an attack on the brigade. 

==Biography==
By [[4 BBY]], Flek had joined the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] to fight against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the brigade was attacked and Flek was apart of a group of at least sixteen members of the brigade that escaped aboard a [[starship]] that landed on [[Yavin 4]]. However [[Bardi's brother|one member]] of the group subsequently departed in the ship leaving Flek and the rest of the group stranded on the [[moon]]. The group later encountered and [[death|killed]] an individual named [[Porko]] that they found near a clearing with a damaged [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

Two [[Standard day|days]] after being stranded on the moon, Porko's companion, a man named [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], landed near the HOY-39 in a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]]. As Andor approached the HOY-39 calling out for Porko the brigade members revealed their presence and took Andor prisoner. As two members of the group [[Gerdis]] and [[Bardi]] took turns trying to interrogate Andor, Flek watched from the sidelines. The interrogation was interrupted when [[Rika]], a member of the group, found the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[pilot]] [[helmet]] in the TIE and proclaimed that Andor was an Imperial test pilot. Later on Flek waited outside the TIE while Rika tried to learn to fly the TIE however after realizing it was a lot more complicated to fly the group discussed the situation with Bardi suggesting that they could threaten to kill Andor. Flek pitched in to suggest they needed a pilot. The meeting was interrupted when Andor learned the group was with the Maya Pei Brigade from his guard with Andor trying but failing to convince the group to trust him.<ref name="One Year Later" /> 

That night, an argument between the group erupted when discussing who should be in charge, ultimately coming to a head when [[Crab]] shot Rika with his blaster and with [[Rowd]] responding by shooting Crab. The brigade members exchange fire while splitting into two factions; with Flek siding with Gerdis, [[Snee]], [[Bayso]], [[Plug]] and [[Snur]] and regrouping with at the HOY-39 with Andor while the other group retreats to the TIE.<ref name="One Year Later" /> Later that night, Flek stayed with the group in the crashed HOY-39 while Snee crawled through the rain looking for Crab. When she found a dismembered portion of Crab's leg she rain back to the group and informed the group. Flek announced that animals must of gotten to them. The following morning the group went through their supplies noting that they had fourteen [[snak-pod]]s and nine [[meal bar]]s but two of them were moldy. Flek stated that he would rather be hungry than sick with Bayso suggesting that they give Andor the moldy one and see what happens. The group later sent Plug to sneak over and find out what the other group was doing at the TIE. He returned to the group to inform them that they were trying to rotate the TIE so so that its weapons would point towards Flek's group. Figuring out they could turn the TIE towards them, the group quickly opened fire at the TIE with their [[blaster]]s thus forcing the TIE group to suspend their effort.<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref>

That night Gerdis decided to issue a challenge to Bardi to settle the dispute. The five members of each groups cross towards leaving Flek to guard Andor. Fleck watched as the two groups meet in the middle and dropped their weapons in unison. The two leaders than began a game of [[Five Hands]] with [[Roski rules]] to decide leadership. When Andor asked what Roski rules were, Flek responded saying it meant total submission. With Flek distracted watching the exchange from the door of the HOY-39, Andor took the opportunity to retrieve a hidden [[MW-20 Bryar pistol]], remove his bindings, gag and bind Flek. He then retrieved a hidden [[fractal radio]] from a different compartment and make his way towards the TIE through the [[jungle]] as the others continued their game of Five Hands. Before Andor could get TIE, a [[Yavinian doodar]] came out of the jungle and scooped Bardi and Gerdis in it's mouth. Meanwhile Flek managed to remove his gag and warn the group that Andor was getting away. However it was too late, with Andor taking off, Flek stood there watching with his hands still bound.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Personality and traits==
Flek had tan skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Equipment==
While stranded on Yavin 4 Flek wore a brown [[clothing|vest]] over a grey shirt and pants with a dark grey scarf.<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flek was portrayed by [[Sonny Poon Tip]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', appearing in the series's first and second episodes, "[[One Year Later]]" and "[[Sagrona Teema]]," which were both released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
